subject: Staged-signature onramp & evaluation milestone plan — Novus Health pilot
messages:
From: Morgan Ellis <morgan.ellis@novushealth.com>
To: soojin_lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot MAP + question on staggered signature for onramp

Hi Soojin / Karthik / Vanessa —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Novus is aligned to run a 2-week eval pilot focused on our clinical summarization workflow. Before we finalize the mutual action plan (attached), I wanted to confirm one operational constraint: our procurement team prefers to sign a minimal order form to unlock sandbox access, then finish DPA review in parallel.

High-level asks from our side:
- Pilot scope: 2 weeks, up to 5k requests/day, up to 100k tokens total.
- Acceptance criteria: P95 latency < 350ms, summary accuracy as measured on our 30-case prompt set (F1 >= 0.82), no PHI ingested into Redwood endpoints during pilot.
- Order of signatures: can we do MSA + Order Form first to enable sandbox and billing, with DPA finalization to follow before any production data?

I attached a draft MAP with milestone dates. Procurement and legal (cc'd: priya) will need to review redlines. If staggered signature is possible, it would shorten our time-to-first-insight.

Thanks — please advise if Redwood requires DPA before any order form signature.

Best,
Morgan Ellis
Head of Product Ops, Novus Health
procurement@novushealth.com

Attachments: Novus_MAP_v1.xlsx
From: soojin_lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Morgan Ellis <morgan.ellis@novushealth.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: legal@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot MAP + question on staggered signature for onramp

Morgan — thanks for the clear ask and the MAP. Happy to run with a staged plan but want to be explicit on constraints so procurement/legal are aligned. Summary below and proposed milestone dates.

Key constraints / Redwood position:
- MSA + Order Form (limited-scope) can be executed to enable sandbox and non-PHI pilot traffic. This assumes Novus will not route PHI to the sandbox environment (we need a signed attestation).
- DPA: required before any production environment or any PHI flows. If Novus cannot guarantee non-PHI, we must finish the DPA first.
- Security evidence: SOC 2 report + KMS/Key management notes can be shared via our secure portal; legal will send a link.

Proposed milestone (draft MAP):
1) 2027-06-16: MSA signed + Limited Order Form signed (sandbox access enabled) — owner: Novus procurement + Redwood sales
2) 2027-06-16 to 2027-06-30: 2-week evaluation in sandbox (no PHI) — owner: Novus engineering
3) 2027-06-18: DPA redline exchange complete and final sign-off target — owner: Novus legal + Redwood legal
4) 2027-07-01: Order Form upgrade for production + activation (only after DPA signed) — owner: Novus procurement + Redwood sales/ops

Risks and mitigations:
- If Novus needs PHI in the pilot: DPA must be finished before sandbox access.
- If DPA negotiation extends beyond 6/18, we can run a read-only trial with synthetic/obfuscated data to keep momentum.

Action items for this thread:
- Morgan / Priya: confirm you accept attestation that pilot traffic will not contain PHI if we proceed with MSA+limited order form (reply in-thread).
- Vanessa / Karthik: can you prepare a clean Order Form with limited scope and a short credit to cover the pilot?
- Redwood legal: we'll circulate SOC2 link and DPA redline by EOD 6/15.

I'll consolidate into a MAP spreadsheet and send an updated timeline once I have confirmations. If helpful, I'll set a 30-min close plan call for 6/15 10:00 AM PT.

— Soojin Lee
Senior Sales Operations Manager | Redwood Inference

Attachments: (see email thread)
From: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Morgan Ellis <morgan.ellis@novushealth.com>, soojin_lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 08:32:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot MAP + question on staggered signature for onramp

All — I'm fine with the staged signature approach as long as order form explicitly limits scope (sandbox only, capped usage) and includes a credit to cover trial usage. Vanessa — can you draft a one-page Order Form that:
- Limits environment to "sandbox / non-production"
- Caps usage to 100k tokens and 5k requests/day
- Includes a $0-$1,000 pilot credit cap (TBD) and expiration date 6/30/2027
- Has a single-line clause referencing the MSA by version (I'll attach the clean MSA)

Vanessa: please add the OrderForm_Redline_v1.pdf to the folder and loop in Billing for quick onboarding. Morgan — pricing note: we can provide a pilot credit; confirm if you prefer a credit line or invoice hold.

-Karthik
From: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@novushealth.com>
To: soojin_lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@novushealth.com
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 10:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot MAP + question on staggered signature for onramp

Thanks — Novus legal has reviewed Redwood's proposal. A few points from our side:
1) We are willing to sign the MSA + limited Order Form to enable a sandbox pilot provided Redwood accepts our redlines to Section 10 (indemnity) and Section 14 (data protection). I've attached our suggested edits.
2) We will not be able to provide an attestation that pilot traffic contains no PHI for all engineering teams. For that reason, we request the DPA be signed prior to any live data transfer. If Redwood cannot commit to executing a DPA by 2027-06-18, we request the sandbox be limited to synthetic/obfuscated data only.
3) Please provide a secure link to the SOC 2 Type II report and a summary of key controls (encryption at-rest/in-transit, KMS, access logs).

We can aim to finalize DPA redlines by EOD 6/18 if Redwood legal is responsive. Procurement remains assigned for commercial signature thereafter.

Regards,
Priya Sharma
Senior Counsel, Novus Health

Subject: Re: Pilot MAP + question on staggered signature for onramp — consolidated MAP and next steps

Team — consolidating the plan based on the last 48 hours of input. Thanks Priya for the redlines; Redwood legal responded inline (see shared drive link). Below is a final mutual action plan for the sandbox pilot and onramp to production.

Final MAP (milestones, owners, and hard dates):
- 2027-06-16: Execute MSA (clean copy) + Limited Order Form (sandbox-only). Owner: Novus procurement + Redwood sales (STATUS: target met if Novus executes; please confirm).
- 2027-06-16 to 2027-06-30: Sandbox evaluation window (no PHI unless DPA signed). Owner: Novus eng + Redwood CS.
- 2027-06-18: DPA redline exchange complete (target). Owner: Novus legal + Redwood legal (STATUS: Redwood legal shared redline 6/15; please confirm next steps).
- 2027-07-01: Production Order Form upgrade & activation (only after signed DPA). Owner: Novus procurement + Redwood billing.

Operational notes:
- Canary clause: If DPA negotiation slips, we will permit a synthetic-data sandbox trial for analysis continuity.
- Escalation path: If legal stalls beyond 6/18, Soojin -> Redwood GC (legal@redwood.com) for priority review and a one-off exec call.
- Security evidence: SOC2 download link: https://secure.redwood.com/soc2/novus (Redwood legal will share access request separately); KMS summary attached in shared folder.

Attachments included in folder: Novus_MAP_v1.xlsx, OrderForm_Redline_v1.pdf, MSA_redlines.docx

Next steps (please reply inline):
- Priya / Morgan: confirm whether Novus will sign the limited Order Form on 6/16 (yes/no). If "no", please confirm target date for DPA completion so we can reschedule the sandbox.
- Vanessa: prepare pilot Order Form with the caps/carryover Karthik requested and send to procurement contact.
- Karthik: confirm the pilot credit amount so Billing can create a one-off credit memo if needed.

I'll hold a 30-min close-planning checkpoint 6/15 10:00 AM PT (calendar invite sent). If any blocker surfaces, call me directly.

Thanks — Soojin
